integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite checks; no third-party full papers embedded; mathematical validation is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only standard odd-order balanced locally transitive carousel tournaments in the pure binary directed-edge relational signature are treated.
Only ordinary first-order logic without counting quantifiers is treated; each quantifier rank is finite.
Computational confirmation is finite; the unbounded-rank assertion relies on a mathematical proof.
Historical priority is qualified by potential stronger differently formulated earlier results.
title: Exact quantifier-rank cutoff for finite carousel tournaments in three-variable logic
